name: Bejeweled Fixes
author: byo-pop
description: Mends faults of the original Bejeweled Deluxe and leaves the game as it was: its look, rules, sounds and pace. Each fix is a toggle; turn the mod off to play the original as it was. High scores and the saved game are shared with the original.

settings.label: Gem selected when the board refills
settings.help: When the board refills (Timed, no move left) the original keeps a gem you had selected, and your next click swaps it back in and loses another. On: the selection is dropped.

settings.label: Saved game's own background
settings.help: The original brings a saved game of level 2 or later back with the first level's background and tint until the next level-up. On: it comes back with its own level's.
